# product-art

Exports: `ArtKind`, `ArtTone`, `ProductArt`

Source: `index.tsx` in this folder. Import: `import { ArtKind, ArtTone, ProductArt } from "@bytesphere/ui"`

## ProductArt

SVG product illustrations (bottle, headphones, chair, lamp, bag, watch) in four tones, so catalogs render without photo assets.

Use when: placeholder product image; svg product picture.
- **Props:** `kind: ArtKind`; `tone: tint|navy|azure|sunken`
- **Live example:** `#/store` in the showcase

```tsx
<ProductArt kind="watch" tone="navy" className="aspect-square" />
```
